stages.protocol: New current-console hex/ASCII dump parser plus existing bounded memory, mutation, stale frame and replacement reference formatter regressions. Test brokers supply DATA; no real-VM acceptance credit.
stages.endpoint: Actual inherited launch authorization, already-executing guest, recurring Wasm breakpoint, bounded memory mutation, quit/EOF release of cooperative or real native trap, same-UID foreign-PID credential rejection, original pidfd process retirement.
stages.broker: Actual stdio DAP: official C source into/next/finish and inline labels; one-opcode Wasm step; copied versus executed native instructions/registers; no native memory authority; session reconnect; inactive function replacement, invalid-body nonpublication and stale references.
stages.source-step: Actual C/C++/Rust embedded compiler DWARF and official line oracle. Into/over/out; full profile adds concrete inline out, repeated same-name sites and recursive same-function out.
stages.source-values: Actual C/C++/Rust source objects and lexical values; full profile adds selected physical/inline frames, next/finish and direct constants. Missing or optimized-away producer capabilities fail.
stages.frame-scope: Actual externally advanced VM stops and a mid-copy stop change must retire old frame/scope/source references before publishing values.
stages.cross-module: Actual leaf/relay/main module identities and exact suspended caller locals across reloads, plus generation/active-target function replacement refusal. No multi-module DWARF source-path claim.
stages.blocked-wait: Optional actual atomic.wait32/wait64 with memory32/memory64: pause an in-flight VM bridge, reject native access, mutate and resume after the real original deadline. No concurrent full-VM hot-swap claim.
